Beat This! small0 ONNX export used by MIDICon AI Assist.
Upstream: https://github.com/CPJKU/beat_this
Paper: Foscarin, Schlüter & Widmer, "Beat This! Accurate Beat Tracking Without DBN Postprocessing", ISMIR 2024.
ONNX mirror: https://github.com/loganjmoore/webxlights/blob/b0006dc0b6466bfa3f98adbec72fba187696d25c/apps/web/public/models/beat-this-small0.onnx
The mirror repository is GPL-3.0; the model file itself is MIT as stated below and in the upstream README.
